name: Wrecking Yard
description: A portrait Unity WebGL build, published to Little Joy Arcade straight from the Unity player: a real 3D scene rather than a 2D approximation, a 9:16 play area that scales to fit any screen, and mouse and touch input. Nothing to install - the payload streams in behind a progress bar and the game runs entirely in the browser.
highlights: Native Unity WebGL build - a real 3D scene, not a 2D stand-in
Portrait 9:16 play area, scaled to fit phones, tablets and desktops
Mouse and touch input, no install and no download
Served from GitHub Pages, with the Unity payload decompressed at deploy time
howToPlay: Open the game and wait for the Unity progress bar - the first load streams about 56 MB
Use the fullscreen button in the footer for the whole 9:16 view
On a phone the game fills the screen automatically
Progress is held by the Unity player in your browser's storage
